Test Case Title: Checkout is refused to a logged-out visitor server side
Preconditions & Test Data: No session cookie. NEXT_PUBLIC_SSR is true.
Test Steps: 1. Clear cookies. 2. Request /cart/checkout/ directly.
Expected Result: A redirect to the login prompt before any page markup is produced.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the route answers 200 and renders

Test Case Title: The payment route is refused to a logged-out visitor server side
Preconditions & Test Data: No session cookie.
Test Steps: 1. Clear cookies. 2. Request /payment/any-slug/ directly.
Expected Result: A redirect to the login prompt.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the route answers 200 and renders

Test Case Title: Every my-account route redirects a logged-out visitor
Preconditions & Test Data: No session cookie.
Test Steps: 1. Request each of /my-account/ and orders and wallet and addresses and profile and transactions and notifications and wishlists and refer-and-earn.
Expected Result: Each answers a redirect to the login prompt.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if every route redirects - the four checked all pass

Test Case Title: The cart does not flash protected content before redirecting
Preconditions & Test Data: No session cookie.
Test Steps: 1. Request /cart/ with a throttled connection. 2. Watch the first paint before hydration completes.
Expected Result: No protected chrome is rendered at any point.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the server returns 200 and the client wrapper redirects only after hydration

Test Case Title: A newly added nested protected route is covered by prefix matching
Preconditions & Test Data: A nested route added under an existing protected prefix.
Test Steps: 1. Add a route under /my-account/ or /cart/. 2. Request it logged out.
Expected Result: It is protected without needing a new entry in the list.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while isProtectedRoute compares by strict equality only

Test Case Title: The identifier availability check does not reveal whether an account exists
Preconditions & Test Data: No authentication.
Test Steps: 1. POST /api/verify-user with a registered email. 2. Repeat with an unregistered email. 3. Compare status and body.
Expected Result: The two responses are indistinguishable.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while a registered identifier returns success and an unregistered one does not

Test Case Title: The availability check is rate limited
Preconditions & Test Data: No authentication.
Test Steps: 1. Issue fifty verify-user requests in quick succession from one source.
Expected Result: A limit engages before the run completes.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while every request is served

Test Case Title: The OTP resend control enforces a cooldown
Preconditions & Test Data: A phone number at the OTP step.
Test Steps: 1. Press resend. 2. Wait for the request to resolve. 3. Press resend again immediately.
Expected Result: The control stays disabled for a fixed window before it can be used again.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the button re-enables the moment the request resolves

Test Case Title: OTP resends are capped per identifier
Preconditions & Test Data: A phone number at the OTP step.
Test Steps: 1. Resend repeatedly for the same number past any reasonable count.
Expected Result: A cap engages and further sends are refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while resends continue indefinitely

Test Case Title: Login credentials never appear in the request URL
Preconditions & Test Data: Any login attempt.
Test Steps: 1. Submit the login form. 2. Read the outgoing request URL in the network panel.
Expected Result: The password appears only in the request body.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while email and password are query parameters

Test Case Title: Registration credentials never appear in the request URL
Preconditions & Test Data: Any registration attempt.
Test Steps: 1. Submit the register form. 2. Read the outgoing request URL.
Expected Result: password and password_confirmation appear only in the body.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while they are query parameters

Test Case Title: The session token is not readable from page JavaScript
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in session.
Test Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Evaluate document.cookie in the console.
Expected Result: The access token is not present - it is httpOnly.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the token is readable

Test Case Title: The session token is not written to localStorage
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in session.
Test Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Read the persist:root key in localStorage.
Expected Result: No access token and no user PII inside the auth slice.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while redux-persist serialises the whole auth slice

Test Case Title: Signing out clears every session scoped local store
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in session that has browsed and searched.
Test Steps: 1. Sign in and use search so history accumulates. 2. Sign out. 3. Read localStorage and cookies and CacheStorage.
Expected Result: Nothing tied to the previous session remains.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while only two localStorage keys and two cookies are cleared

Test Case Title: The location cookie does not survive sign out
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in session with a delivery location set.
Test Steps: 1. Set a location. 2. Sign out. 3. Read the userLocation cookie.
Expected Result: It is removed.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while it persists with a one year expiry

Test Case Title: Logout completes even when the logout request or navigation fails
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in session on a my-account route.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger logout and interrupt the navigation so Router.push rejects.
Expected Result: The local session is cleared regardless and the user ends signed out.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the catch calls process.exit and throws

Test Case Title: A failed availability request is not treated as available
Preconditions & Test Data: The panel returning 500 for verify-user.
Test Steps: 1. Force the endpoint to fail. 2. Enter an address that is already registered and blur the field.
Expected Result: An error state is shown rather than silence.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while a request failure is indistinguishable from not found

Test Case Title: An absolute or protocol relative next parameter is not followed
Preconditions & Test Data: No session.
Test Steps: 1. Request /?auth=required&next=https://evil.tld then //evil.tld then a backslash variant. 2. Sign in.
Expected Result: Every case lands on a same-origin path.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if safeNext rejects each - the absolute and protocol relative forms are confirmed handled

Test Case Title: A valid next parameter returns the user to the intended page
Preconditions & Test Data: No session and a protected destination.
Test Steps: 1. Request a protected route logged out. 2. Sign in from the prompt.
Expected Result: The user lands on the originally requested route.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if next survives the auth flow

Test Case Title: Firebase auth errors render in the active language
Preconditions & Test Data: Language set to Arabic or Hindi.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger an invalid code and an attempt-limit error.
Expected Result: Both messages render in the selected language.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while getFirebaseErrorMessage returns hard-coded English

Test Case Title: The auth sheet shows a loading state on every async action
Preconditions & Test Data: The auth sheet open.
Test Steps: 1. Submit each of login and register and send-otp and verify-otp and reset.
Expected Result: Each disables its trigger and shows inline loading.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if every action gates its own control

Test Case Title: Every auth failure surfaces a message
Preconditions & Test Data: The panel unreachable.
Test Steps: 1. Attempt each auth action with the backend down.
Expected Result: Each surfaces an error toast rather than failing silently.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if no path swallows the failure

Test Case Title: The auth sheet is fully operable by keyboard
Preconditions & Test Data: The auth sheet open.
Test Steps: 1. Traverse every control with Tab. 2. Submit with Enter. 3. Close with Esc.
Expected Result: Every control is reachable and operable - focus is trapped and restored on close.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if focus never escapes to the page behind

Test Case Title: The auth sheet mirrors correctly in Arabic
Preconditions & Test Data: Language set to Arabic.
Test Steps: 1. Open the auth sheet at 375 and at 1280.
Expected Result: Spacing and alignment and the OTP field order mirror with the text.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL wherever physical direction classes are used

Test Case Title: An expired or revoked token ends the session cleanly
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in session whose token is revoked server side.
Test Steps: 1. Revoke the token. 2. Perform any authenticated action.
Expected Result: The user is signed out locally and prompted to sign in again.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the 401 path clears local state and does not loop

Test Case Title: A quantity request is never stored below the product minimum
Preconditions & Test Data: A product with minQuantity 3 and stepSize 2.
Test Steps: 1. Request quantity 3 for that product while logged out. 2. Read the stored quantity.
Expected Result: The stored quantity is at or above 3 and satisfies the step rule.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the clamp returns 2

Test Case Title: The step rule is applied relative to the minimum rather than to zero
Preconditions & Test Data: A product with minQuantity 3 and stepSize 2.
Test Steps: 1. Request quantities 3 and 4 and 5 and 6 in turn. 2. Record each stored value.
Expected Result: Each lands on a valid step offset from the minimum and never below it.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while values snap to absolute multiples of the step

Test Case Title: Merging two offline lines clamps the summed quantity to stock
Preconditions & Test Data: Two lines of quantity 4 for a variant with stock 5 differing only by addons.
Test Steps: 1. Create both lines. 2. Edit one so its addons match the other and the ids collide. 3. Read the merged quantity.
Expected Result: The merged quantity is clamped to 5.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the merge returns 8

Test Case Title: The subtotal matches the clamped quantity after a merge
Preconditions & Test Data: The merge in TC-CART-003.
Test Steps: 1. Perform the merge. 2. Compare the subtotal against quantity multiplied by unit price plus addons.
Expected Result: The subtotal reflects the clamped quantity.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the subtotal is computed from the unclamped 8

Test Case Title: The offline cart does not survive sign out
Preconditions & Test Data: A guest session with items in the offline cart on a shared device.
Test Steps: 1. Add items as a guest. 2. Sign in and then sign out. 3. Read the persisted offlineCart slice in localStorage.
Expected Result: The slice is empty after sign out.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while handleLogout never clears it

Test Case Title: A leftover offline cart is not merged into the next account that signs in
Preconditions & Test Data: A non-empty offline cart left by a previous user on the device.
Test Steps: 1. Leave items in the offline cart. 2. Sign in as a different account. 3. Read that account server cart.
Expected Result: The new account cart contains only its own items.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while every login path calls syncOfflineCartToServer unconditionally

Test Case Title: A failed sync does not leave items behind for the next session
Preconditions & Test Data: A sync that returns success false.
Test Steps: 1. Force the sync to fail. 2. Sign out. 3. Read the offlineCart slice.
Expected Result: Nothing is left that a later sign in would pick up.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the failure branch returns without clearing

Test Case Title: Items the server rejects are kept rather than deleted
Preconditions & Test Data: An offline cart where one item is out of stock or not sellable in the active market.
Test Steps: 1. Populate the offline cart with one valid and one unsellable item. 2. Sign in and let the sync run. 3. Read the offline cart and the server cart.
Expected Result: The rejected item remains recoverable and is surfaced to the customer.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while clearOfflineCart runs before failed_items is inspected

Test Case Title: Rejected items are surfaced even when the failed items modal is not mounted
Preconditions & Test Data: A sync returning failed_items on a route where the modal is absent.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger a sync with rejections from such a route. 2. Observe what the customer is told.
Expected Result: The rejection is communicated regardless of which component is mounted.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the notice depends on a window global that is deleted on unmount

Test Case Title: The server cart is not rehydrated from localStorage on boot
Preconditions & Test Data: A logged-in session with a cart that changed on another device.
Test Steps: 1. Populate the cart. 2. Change it elsewhere. 3. Reopen the storefront and read the cart before revalidation completes.
Expected Result: The first paint shows server truth or a loading state - not a persisted copy.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while cart is in the redux-persist whitelist

Test Case Title: An empty cart renders the empty state rather than an error
Preconditions & Test Data: An empty cart and a panel whose empty-cart message wording has changed.
Test Steps: 1. Empty the cart. 2. Change or localise the panel message. 3. Reload the cart.
Expected Result: The empty state renders and the checkout state is reset.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the branch matches the English string Your cart is empty

Test Case Title: Emptying the cart resets promo and wallet selections
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart with a promo code applied and wallet selected.
Test Steps: 1. Apply a promo and select wallet. 2. Empty the cart. 3. Begin a new cart and reach checkout.
Expected Result: No promo or wallet selection carries over.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL whenever the empty branch is missed so resetCheckOutState never runs

Test Case Title: Cart status messages render in the active language
Preconditions & Test Data: Language set to Arabic or Hindi.
Test Steps: 1. Empty the cart and force a cart refresh failure. 2. Read both toasts.
Expected Result: Both render in the selected language.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while four cart toasts are hard-coded English

Test Case Title: The removed items notice appears regardless of which route is active
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart refresh returning removed_count above zero on a route where the modal is not mounted.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger the refresh from such a route. 2. Observe whether the notice opens.
Expected Result: The customer is told which items were removed.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the trigger is a hidden DOM button click

Test Case Title: Quantity cannot exceed the maximum or the available stock
Preconditions & Test Data: A product with maxQuantity 10 and stock 4.
Test Steps: 1. Request quantity 20. 2. Read the stored quantity.
Expected Result: The stored quantity is 4.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if both ceilings are applied

Test Case Title: Adding the same variant twice sums and re-clamps rather than duplicating the line
Preconditions & Test Data: A product already in the offline cart.
Test Steps: 1. Add the same variant again. 2. Read the line count and the quantity.
Expected Result: One line remains and the quantity is the clamped sum.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the merge path re-clamps

Test Case Title: The offline subtotal includes addon prices
Preconditions & Test Data: A product with two addons priced above zero.
Test Steps: 1. Add it with both addons. 2. Compare the subtotal against quantity multiplied by unit price plus addon prices.
Expected Result: The subtotal includes the addons.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if addons are summed into the line total

Test Case Title: No client supplied price is sent to the server on sync
Preconditions & Test Data: An offline cart with a tampered price value in localStorage.
Test Steps: 1. Edit the persisted price. 2. Sign in and let the sync run. 3. Inspect the sync request body and the resulting cart totals.
Expected Result: Only ids and quantities and addons are sent and the server prices the cart.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if price is absent from the payload

Test Case Title: An oversized or disallowed attachment is refused
Preconditions & Test Data: A file above the size limit and a file of a disallowed type.
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to attach each. 2. Read the response.
Expected Result: Both are refused with a message.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the size check and the type allowlist both hold

Test Case Title: The cart shows all four states
Preconditions & Test Data: An empty cart then a populated cart then the panel offline.
Test Steps: 1. Load the cart in each condition. 2. Record what renders.
Expected Result: Loading shows a skeleton - empty shows the empty state - failure shows an error with retry - populated shows the items.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if a failed fetch is distinguishable from an empty cart

Test Case Title: Every cart mutation reports success and failure
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart with items and a panel that can be taken offline.
Test Steps: 1. Change quantity and remove an item and apply a promo with the panel up then down.
Expected Result: Each action surfaces a toast either way and disables its trigger while in flight.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if no path fails silently

Test Case Title: Switching market re-prices the cart and drops unsellable items
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart populated in market A and a second market with different pricing.
Test Steps: 1. Populate the cart in market A. 2. Switch to market B. 3. Read the cart contents and currency.
Expected Result: The cart is repriced in market B and anything unsellable there is surfaced.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the cart is refetched under the new market header

Test Case Title: The cart and its stepper are usable at every breakpoint
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart with several items and long product titles.
Test Steps: 1. Load the cart at 375 and 769 and 1280. 2. Operate the stepper at each.
Expected Result: Layout holds and the stepper is operable with no horizontal page scroll.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if long titles do not force overflow

Test Case Title: The cart quantity stepper is operable by keyboard
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart with one item.
Test Steps: 1. Tab to the stepper. 2. Increase and decrease with the keyboard. 3. Confirm the value is announced.
Expected Result: Both controls are reachable and operable and carry accessible names.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the icon-only buttons have labels

Test Case Title: Rapid quantity changes settle on the final value
Preconditions & Test Data: A cart with one item.
Test Steps: 1. Press increment five times quickly. 2. Wait for the debounce to settle. 3. Compare the displayed quantity against the server cart.
Expected Result: One request is sent for the final value and both agree.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the debounce coalesces and the server value wins
